title: RC ULTIMATE AUTO FARM
features:
MAIN FEATURES:

POWER & BRAKE SYSTEM

• SPEED Multiplier (1x to 100x) – adjustable from the menu.

• BRAKING Force (1% to 50%) – adjustable from the menu.

• Full control with the W (accelerate) and S (brake) keys or with the touch buttons.

COMPLETE AUTO FARM

• AUTO-BUY: Automatically buys cars based on the selected rarity.

• FULL FARM: Buys → repairs → sells cars in an automatic cycle.

• RARITY Filters: Choose which rarities you want to farm (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary).

• AREA ROTATION: Teleports between zones to find more cars.

AUTO-COLLECT

• Automatically collects money and parts from your base.

• Configurable 5-minute interval.

• Manual button for instant collection.

AUTO-DELIVERY

• Automatically picks up and delivers items.

• No teleportation bugs: simply dismounts, picks up, and remounts.

• 30-second cooldown between deliveries.

COMPATIBILITY

• Works on MOBILE and PC.

• Interface adapts to any screen size.

• Touch controls with haptic feedback

Tip: Make the script buy a lot of cars, the price doesn't matter as long as you buy a lot, and you can repair and sell them, that way you earn a lot more xd my tip
